sources.title: SEO-AI-003-2026-08-22-R1
supports: A real dated First-Party internal-link task was executed against the public production site at commit 0f5eac6.
Ten source passages, canonical 200 sources and targets, and missing main-content target links were validated by a reproducible read-only harness.
An HTTP-derived First-Party page fixture freezes status, canonical, main text, main links and full-body hashes so the historical checks remain replayable after the live site changes.
Naturalness, placement and editorial value are not independently human-reviewed; the result status is partial and establishes no provider ranking or SEO outcome.
sources.rights: Original project task output and First-Party validation artifacts. No third-party provider output, screenshot, customer data, or ranking is reproduced.
